ideas.pitch: A high-mobility soccer robot utilizing omnidirectional wheels within the 350x350mm limit for rapid lateral maneuvers.
ideas.problem_statement: Robo Soccer: Build a custom-built, wirelessly controlled robot to maneuver a ball into the opponent's goal within 350x350 mm and 3 kg limits.
ideas.title: OmniStrike RoboSoccer Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages an unusual physical build pattern and direct live maneuverability demonstration that wins physical robotics tournaments.

ideas.pitch: A competition-ready soccer robot featuring an electromagnetic solenoid kick mechanism that complies strictly with the 3S LiPo 12V voltage limit.
ideas.problem_statement: Robo Soccer: Build a custom-built, wirelessly controlled robot to maneuver a ball into the opponent's goal while keeping ball handling compliant with the 50% surface rule.
ideas.title: Pneumatic-Free Solenoid Kicker Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges in a knockout tournament value reliability and high-speed shooting without violating pneumatic bans.

ideas.pitch: A custom handheld gamepad using a dual-core microcontroller providing sub-20ms wireless response time for precision robot steering.
ideas.problem_statement: Robo Soccer: Fully wireless (RF or Bluetooth) manual control within the specified match duration.
ideas.title: Low-Latency Bluetooth LE Soccer Controller
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on operator control ergonomics and zero lag, which directly determines tournament outcomes in fast-paced knockout rounds.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight 3D-printed chassis designed to strictly satisfy the 50% ball surface exposure rule while preventing opponents from stealing the ball.
ideas.problem_statement: Robo Soccer: At least 50% of the ball's surface must remain exposed at all times under a 3 kg weight limit.
ideas.title: Open-Cage Ball-Guard Chassis
ideas.why_it_could_win: Ensures absolute rule compliance during technical inspection while maximizing defensive maneuverability.

ideas.pitch: A high-torque, gear-reduced differential drive robot tuned for maximum acceleration and pushing power within the 3 kg threshold.
ideas.problem_statement: Robo Soccer: Balancing speed, control, and defensive strategy to outmaneuver opponents within a 3 kg maximum weight limit.
ideas.title: Dual-Motor Differential Drive Striker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emphasizes a robust, battle-tested mechanical layout that survives intense physical collisions in the volleyball court arena.
